title: Virginia Tech War Memorial Honor Court
summary: A conceptual design to renew Virginia Tech's Alumni Mall as a plaza that can close to traffic, with bands of light set flush in the paving.
reviewNote: Existing text from the current site. "Softly- illuminated" and the spelling of Torgersen were corrected. The client, the year and the four-part story are still to come.
description: Conceptual design for renewal of Virginia Tech's historic Alumni Mall following its bifurcation by Torgersen Bridge completed 2000. The scheme envisions periodic closure of the space to vehicular traffic for conversion to a pedestrian-only, center-campus plaza. Softly illuminated, flush-with-paving light bands inspired by Peter Walker and Partners IBM Makuhari Building, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The scheme manifests Tech's dedication to innovation while respectful of historic tradition. Perspectives by Peter Giraudeau. Design by Bartenstein while senior landscape architect with Hill Studio.
